sentences.text:
Munni Devi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19
January, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 85
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 12053 of 2022
Applicant :- Munni Devi And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Gauri Shankar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.

Heard Sri Gauri Shankar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the
State perused the papers on record.

02. The present application has been moved by the applicants Munni Devi, Lakshmi Devi, Jyoti
seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 348 of 2021, Under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 and
325 I.P.C. Police Station- Bishrakh, District- Gautam Buddh Nagar.

03.  As per prosecution case, the first informant Dipika was being continuously harassed by her husband and other members of her family in order to coerce her for bringing more dowry; they habitually indulged in abusive language and physically assaulted her; she was harassed to such an extent that she was about to commit suicide and while attempting the same she cut her wrist vein.
The matter was investigated upon and the charge sheet has been submitted.

04. It is contended on behalf of the applicant; that the applicant no. 1 being mother-in-law applicant no. 2 being real sister of the husband of the so called victim and Jyoti being wife of her Devar have been implicated in this false case out of vengeance; the real dispute lies between the first informant and her husband; it is contended that there are no direct allegations against them as far as offence under section 323, 504, 506 and 325 is concerned; the material allegations have been imputed against the husband and his younger brother.

It is also contended that a divorce suit filed on behalf of the first informant against her husband is pending since 08.07.2020 i.e. before filing of the present F.I.R.; the instant case has been filed on 21.05.2021 in a mala fide manner in retaliation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The application for anticipatory bail is opposed by the learned A.G.A. for the State.
Undisputedly the major part of allegations are against the husband and his younger brother and there are only general allegations against the present applicants.

06. In case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 07. In the instant case, I considered submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances of the case.
In my view a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicants.

10. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.

Order Date :- 19.1.2023/Gaurav  Munni Devi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56326734/
